sceneCollisionSource.liftThresholdPolicy: 32 measured doorway-width zones, 0.20 m outside the threshold, reserved for boarding/alighting; 0.8 m external lobbies retained
sceneCollisionSource.method: Transformed GLB accessor-extrema OBBs and actual support cylinders, baked into the existing CAD mask only where their vertical extent meets a body slab. Cell erosion equals supported radius plus half-cell diagonal. Bounding proxies conservatively forbid exhibit interiors; no exact animated limb/cloth collision or foot IK.
